evals.prompt: Escreve o e-mail da nossa Black Friday para quem se cadastrou e nunca usou o produto. Quero barulho, ser agressivo em aquisição.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or uses a taste reference, opens on no own news, names the thing, and uses writers and cold critics before showing one version.
assertions: The subject states the offer or the product plainly and names what it is
No invented scarcity such as vagas or a countdown appears
The output says which critics read it, and any persona is labelled a simulation

evals.prompt: Faz a mensagem para eu postar num grupo de WhatsApp de fornecedores de e-commerce. Marca desconhecida, ninguém pagou ainda.
evals.expected_output: A group post with one call to action that makes the reader feel safe, with no testimonial or customer count.
assertions: No testimonial, customer count or result number appears
Exactly one call to action appears
A risk reversal appears before the price

evals.prompt: Esse assunto tá bom? 'Vender em marketplace virou segundo emprego'
evals.expected_output: Rejects it for supposing the reader's business and proposes plain alternatives.
assertions: The answer says the line supposes the size of the reader's business
At least two alternatives state the offer or thing plainly
